ingest_disposition.reason: The newest inbox packet observed at reentry is the already-accounted Stop-hook packet. This delta cross-checks and fuses existing source evidence rather than minting duplicate packet consumption.

direct_source_crosscheck.finding: When gespraech.aktiv has admitted this listener path, every non-empty speech_end starts Realtime without the wake-word matcher. The Realtime call passes API/config/session context but no dedicated activation_event_id, audio-segment identity, transcript digest or activation generation. After return, a waiting-for-Hey-FranKenstein pulse is still emitted, preserving stale wake-word wording beside the newer reactive activation law.

Immediate tool output is returned as function_call_output bound to the original call_id. Later asynchronous completion preserves auftrag_id only in best-effort outcome logging, then re-enters the model-facing conversation as a new role=user input_text item that carries neither the original call_id nor a typed task/result join.

fusion_with_stop_hook_delta.shared_failure_shape: Deferred or slow cognition/result work is rejoined through context-local ordering or weak identifiers rather than one replay-stable origin identity plus generation.
fusion_with_stop_hook_delta.shared_nonclaim: The similarity is an architecture synthesis, not evidence that the two paths share one runtime bug or one implementation.

architecture_effect.purpose: Provide one typed interconnect shape for request-scoped cognition and asynchronous result re-entry while preserving subsystem-specific payload schemas.
subsystem_specializations: RetrievalRelevanceCandidate retains exact retrieval_id plus turn/causal generation and model-derived evidence classification.
VoiceActivationBinding/v1 retains activation_event_id, enable generation, audio/transcript provenance and Realtime invocation identity.
VoiceAsyncReturnBinding/v1 retains original call_id, task/auftrag_id, task generation, submission/completion receipts and conversation re-entry identity.

sparse_world_substrate_binding.rule: Local transcript activation, model relevance judgments and asynchronous textual result reports may become typed evidence inputs or candidate returns, but none may mint canonical world facts merely by entering a model context. Exact observation/effect provenance remains outside vector/model cognition.

contradictions_preserved: Reactive voice activation no longer requires a wake word, while post-session status text still says it waits for Hey FranKenstein.
Immediate Realtime tool results preserve call_id, while asynchronous completion re-entry loses the same protocol-level call binding in the model-facing conversation.
Stop-hook source declares no LLM calls in hooks while its live Stop path performs synchronous Ollama relevance inference; this remains source-scope contradictory semantics with runtime credit zero.
counterhypotheses: Chronological single-task operation may often associate asynchronous completion correctly in practice, but chronology is not a deterministic join and must be falsified under overlapping reverse-order completions.
An installed/private wrapper outside the pinned donor may add stronger activation or completion identities; that remains UNKNOWN until exact installed-source evidence is observed.

A generalized DeferredCausalReturnEnvelope may be unnecessary if three subsystem-specific bindings prove simpler and equally auditable; Triggerword-4 should keep the shared envelope only if it reduces duplicated authority/identity logic without erasing subsystem semantics.

required_discriminators: Two same-session retrieval episodes with reversed completion; relevance must attach only to the exact retrieval_id/turn/generation.
Cognition-disabled, warm, slow/cold and unreachable local-model Stop conditions; deterministic later Stop bookkeeping must remain complete.
Two overlapping background voice/tool tasks completing in reverse order; each result must preserve original call_id plus task generation through model re-entry.
Activation replay/provenance test proving two distinct non-empty speech_end events cannot collapse to one activation identity.
Transport-role test proving an internal asynchronous result cannot be reclassified as human-originated speech merely because the provider API uses a message item.

next_exact_gate: Triggerword-4/external non-provider test lane: decide whether DeferredCausalReturnEnvelope/v1 is a useful shared ABI or keep the three bindings separate, then execute reverse-order overlap tests for retrieval and asynchronous voice returns plus slow/unreachable local-model Stop bookkeeping without modifying Frank's Harness.
